findings.chapter: Chapter 5 — From Workload to Model Selection
findings.evidence: “Llama‑2 70B, like Llama‑3 70B, is a GQA‑8 checkpoint: the released configuration lists 64 attention heads and only 8 key/value heads (num_key_value_heads = 8) [1P][FACT]”
findings.issue: Factual error: Llama-2 70B uses full multi-head attention with 64 KV heads, not GQA-8. The cited 64-query/8-KV-head configuration is Llama-3 70B. The sentence also repeats this claim on the same page, and it is used to derive a ~0.33 MB/token KV figure that is correct for Llama-3 70B but wrong for Llama-2 70B.
findings.fix_instruction: Replace “Llama‑2 70B, like Llama‑3 70B” with “Llama‑3 70B” only, or explicitly state that Llama-2 70B is full-MHA with 64 KV heads and would use the ~2.62 MB/token full-MHA constant. Re-check the surrounding arithmetic so the ~0.33 MB/token and ~3.0 GB figures are attributed only to the GQA-8 Llama-3 70B checkpoint.
